name: Tasbeeh - Dhikr & Dua Tracker
description:
Stay consistent with your daily dhikr and build a stronger spiritual routine.

Tasbeeh is designed to be simple, focused, and distraction-free, helping you remember Allah throughout your day without complexity or overwhelm.

Key Features

• Easy dhikr counting with a clean interface
• Focus mode for distraction-free recitation
• Post-salah adhkar guidance
• Personal dhikr list and favorites
• Lightweight, fast, and offline-friendly

Why Tasbeeh?
Most apps are overloaded with features. Tasbeeh keeps it simple, so you can focus on what truly matters: your remembrance of Allah.

Whether after salah or throughout the day, Tasbeeh helps you stay consistent, mindful, and spiritually connected.
